sentences.zh: 漢興，接秦之獘，丈夫從軍旅，老弱轉糧馕，作業劇而財匱，自天子不能具鈞駟，而將相或乘牛車，齊民無藏蓋。

translations.literal: Han rose, connected Qin exhaustion, men followed military campaigns, old weak transported grain food, work intense and wealth scarce, from Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, and generals ministers or rode ox carts, common people no stored covers.
translations.idiomatic: When Han rose, it inherited Qin’s exhaustion. Men followed military campaigns, and the old and infirm transported grain and food. Labor was heavy and wealth scarce; even the Son of Heaven could not equip matched horses, while generals and ministers sometimes rode ox carts and commoners had nothing in reserve.

sentences.zh: 於是為秦錢重難用，更令民鑄錢，一黃金一斤，約法省禁。

translations.literal: Therefore, because Qin coinage was heavy and hard to use, they further ordered the people to cast money, with one catty of gold to one jin, and regulated the laws while reducing prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, because Qin coinage was heavy and hard to use, they further ordered the people to cast money, fixing the value at one catty of gold per jin, and regulated the laws while reducing prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 而不軌逐利之民，蓄積餘業以稽市物，物踴騰糶，米至石萬錢，馬一匹則百金。

translations.literal: And lawless profit-seeking people accumulated surplus stock to control market goods; goods leaped in price, rice reached ten thousand cash per shi, and one horse then cost a hundred gold.
translations.idiomatic: People who broke the rules to pursue profit hoarded surplus goods to control the market, driving prices up. Rice reached ten thousand cash per shi, and a single horse cost a hundred gold.

sentences.zh: 天下已平，高祖乃令賈人不得衣絲乘車，重租稅以困辱之。

translations.literal: World already pacified, Gao Zu then ordered merchants not wear silk ride carriages, heavy taxes to distress humiliate them.
translations.idiomatic: After the realm was pacified, Emperor Gaozu then ordered that merchants could not wear silk or ride carriages and imposed heavy taxes to disgrace them.

sentences.zh: 孝惠、高后時，為天下初定，復弛商賈之律，然市井之子孫亦不得仕宦為吏。

translations.literal: Xiao Hui, Gao Hou time, because world initially settled, again relaxed merchant laws, yet marketplace sons grandsons also not allowed serve as officials be clerks.
translations.idiomatic: During the time of Emperor Xiaohui and Empress Dowager Gao, since the realm had only just been settled, they again relaxed the laws on merchants, yet the sons and grandsons of the marketplace still could not serve as officials or clerks.

sentences.zh: 量吏祿，度官用，以賦於民。

translations.literal: Measured clerk salaries, estimated official expenses, to levy on people.
translations.idiomatic: They measured clerk salaries and estimated official expenses, then levied them on the people.

sentences.zh: 而山川園池市井租稅之入，自天子以至于封君湯沐邑，皆各為私奉養焉，不領於天下之經費。

translations.literal: And mountains rivers parks ponds marketplace tax incomes, from Son of Heaven down to sealed lords hot bath towns, all each for private support, not included in world regular expenses.
translations.idiomatic: And the revenues from mountains, rivers, parks, ponds, and marketplaces, from the Son of Heaven down to the enfeoffed lords and their hot-spring estates, were all reserved for private support and not counted in the realm’s ordinary expenses.

sentences.zh: 漕轉山東粟，以給中都官，歲不過數十萬石。

translations.literal: Transported transferred Shan Dong grain, to supply central capital officials, year not over several ten thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Grain from Shandong was transported to supply the central offices, and the yearly total did not exceed several hundred thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 至孝文時，莢錢益多，輕，乃更鑄四銖錢，其文為「半兩」，令民縱得自鑄錢。

translations.literal: To Xiaowen’s time, elm-seed tokens grew many and light; then they recast four-zhu money, its inscription “half liang,” and ordered the people freely to cast money.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Xiaowen, elm-seed tokens had grown numerous and light, so they cast new four-zhu coins bearing the inscription “half liang,” and allowed the people to cast coins freely.

sentences.zh: 故吳諸侯也，以即山鑄錢，富埒天子，其後卒以叛逆。

translations.literal: Therefore, Wu feudal lord, by near mountain cast money, rich equal Son of Heaven, his after finally with rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the feudal lord of Wu cast coins near the mountains, became as rich as the Son of Heaven, and later finally rebelled.

sentences.zh: 鄧通，大夫也，以鑄錢財過王者。

translations.literal: Deng Tong, grand master, with casting money wealth exceeded kings.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Tong, a grand master, grew richer than kings by casting money.

sentences.zh: 故吳、鄧氏錢布天下，而鑄錢之禁生焉。

translations.literal: Therefore, Wu, Deng clan money spread world, and casting money prohibition born there.
translations.idiomatic: Thus, the coinage of Wu and the Deng clan spread throughout the realm, and the prohibition on casting money arose from it.

sentences.zh: 匈奴數侵盜北邊，屯戍者多，邊粟不足給食當食者。

translations.literal: Xiongnu frequently invaded robbed north border, garrisoned defended many, border grain insufficient supply food should eat ones.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiongnu frequently invaded and robbed the northern border, and those who garrisoned and defended were many, so border grain was insufficient to supply food to those who should eat.

sentences.zh: 於是募民能輸及轉粟於邊者拜爵，爵得至大庶長。

translations.literal: Therefore, they recruited people who could transport grain to the border and granted nobility ranks up to the rank of Grand Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, they recruited people who could transport grain to the border and granted nobility ranks up to the rank of Grand Chief.

sentences.zh: 孝景時，上郡以西旱，亦復修賣爵令，而賤其價以招民；

translations.literal: Xiao Jing time, Shang Jun west drought, also again repaired sell nobility rank command, and cheapened its price to attract people;
translations.idiomatic: During the time of Emperor Xiaojing, when there was a drought west of Shangjun, they also again repaired the order to sell nobility ranks, and cheapened their prices to attract people;

sentences.zh: 及徒復作，得輸粟縣官以除罪。

translations.literal: And convict labor again worked, got transport grain county officials to remove crime.
translations.idiomatic: And those who did convict labor again could transport grain to the county officials to remove their crimes.

sentences.zh: 益造苑馬以廣用，而宮室列觀輿馬益增修矣。

translations.literal: Moreover, made garden horses to broaden use, and palace rooms arranged towers carriages horses moreover increased repaired.
translations.idiomatic: They further made garden horses to broaden their use, and the palace rooms, arranged towers, carriages, and horses were increasingly added and repaired.

sentences.zh: 至今上即位數歲，漢興七十餘年之閒，國家無事，非遇水旱之災，民則人給家足，都鄙廩庾皆滿，而府庫餘貨財。

translations.literal: To now emperor ascended throne several years, Han rise seventy more years between, nation no affairs, not encounter water drought disasters, people then person supplied house sufficient, cities towns granaries all full, and treasuries surplus goods wealth.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the present emperor had been on the throne for several years, in the more than seventy years since Han rose, the nation had no affairs. When they did not encounter water or drought disasters, the people then had each person supplied and each house sufficient, the granaries of cities and towns were all full, and the treasuries had surplus goods and wealth.

sentences.zh: 京師之錢累巨萬，貫朽而不可校。

translations.literal: Capital money accumulated huge ten thousand, strings rotted and could not be counted.
translations.idiomatic: The money in the capital accumulated in huge amounts of ten thousands, and the strings rotted and could not be counted.

sentences.zh: 太倉之粟陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。

translations.literal: Great granary grain old old mutually followed, full overflowed exposed piled outside, to rotten could not be eaten.
translations.idiomatic: The grain in the great granary, old grain following old grain, was full and overflowed, exposed and piled outside, until it rotted and could not be eaten.

sentences.zh: 眾庶街巷有馬，阡陌之閒成群，而乘字牝者儐而不得聚會。

translations.literal: The masses in streets and alleys had horses, and between paths and crossroads they formed groups; those who rode government-branded mares were shunned and could not gather for meetings.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners in streets and alleys had horses, and along the paths and crossroads they formed groups; those who rode government-branded mares were shunned and could not gather for meetings.

sentences.zh: 守閭閻者食粱肉，為吏者長子孫，居官者以為姓號。

translations.literal: Guarded alley gates ate fine grain meat, served as clerks extended sons grandsons, resided as officials took as surname appellation.
translations.idiomatic: Those who guarded the alley gates ate fine grain and meat, those who served as clerks extended their sons and grandsons, and those who resided as officials took it as their surname and appellation.

sentences.zh: 故人人自愛而重犯法，先行義而後絀恥辱焉。

translations.literal: Therefore, each person self loved and valued not violate law, first practiced righteousness then shrank from shame humiliation.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, each person loved themselves and valued not violating the law, first practiced righteousness, and then shrank from shame and humiliation.

sentences.zh: 當此之時，網疏而民富，役財驕溢，或至兼并豪黨之徒，以武斷於鄉曲。

translations.literal: When this time, net loose and people rich, corvee wealth arrogant overflowing, or to annexed merged powerful faction followers, with military decided in rural areas.
translations.idiomatic: At this time, the net was loose and the people were rich. They used their wealth arrogantly and overflowingly, and some even annexed and merged with powerful faction followers, using military force to decide matters in rural areas.

sentences.zh: 宗室有土公卿大夫以下，爭于奢侈，室廬輿服僭于上，無限度。

translations.literal: Imperial clan had land dukes ministers grand masters below, contended in luxury, rooms houses carriages clothing usurped superiors, no limits.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clan, those with land, dukes, ministers, and grand masters and below, contended in luxury, and their rooms, houses, carriages, and clothing usurped those of their superiors, with no limits.

sentences.zh: 物盛而衰，固其變也。

translations.literal: Things flourish then decline, certainly their change.
translations.idiomatic: When things flourish, they then decline; this is certainly their change.

sentences.zh: 自是之後，嚴助、朱買臣等招來東甌，事兩越，江淮之閒蕭然煩費矣。

translations.literal: After this, Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen, and others summoned Dong'ou, dealt with the two Yue, and between the Jiang and Huai the region was drained and expenses mounted.
translations.idiomatic: After this, Yan Zhu, Zhu Maichen, and others brought in Dong'ou, dealt with the two Yue, and between the Jiang and Huai the region was drained and expenses mounted.

sentences.zh: 唐蒙、司馬相如開路西南夷，鑿山通道千餘里，以廣巴蜀，巴蜀之民罷焉。

translations.literal: Tang Meng, Sima Xiang Ru opened road southwest barbarians, chiseled mountain opened path thousand more li, to broaden Ba Shu, Ba Shu people exhausted there.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Meng and Sima Xiangru opened roads to the southwest barbarians, chiseled mountains and opened paths for more than a thousand li, to broaden Bashu, and the people of Bashu were exhausted by this.

sentences.zh: 彭吳賈滅朝鮮，置滄海之郡，則燕齊之閒靡然發動。

translations.literal: Peng Wujia destroyed Joseon and established Canghai Commandery, and then between Yan and Qi resources were massively mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Wujia destroyed Joseon and established Canghai Commandery, and then between Yan and Qi resources were massively mobilized.

sentences.zh: 及王恢設謀馬邑，匈奴絕和親，侵擾北邊，兵連而不解，天下苦其勞，而干戈日滋。

translations.literal: When Wang Hui set his stratagem at Mayi, the Xiongnu broke off the heqin alliance, invaded and harassed the northern border, wars continued without end, the realm suffered from the labor, and arms daily increased.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Hui set his stratagem at Mayi, the Xiongnu broke off the heqin alliance, invaded and harassed the northern border, wars continued without end, the realm suffered from the labor, and arms daily increased.

sentences.zh: 行者齎，居者送，中外騷擾而相奉，百姓抏獘以巧法，財賂衰秏而不贍。

translations.literal: Travelers carried provisions, residents sent, inside outside disturbed mutually supplied, hundred surnames constrained exhausted with skillful laws, wealth bribes declined expended not sufficient.
translations.idiomatic: Travelers carried provisions, residents supplied them, and the inner and outer regions were thrown into mutual disturbance. The common people were worn down by shrewd regulations, their wealth dwindled, their bribes ran short, and still these were not enough.

sentences.zh: 入物者補官，出貨者除罪，選舉陵遲，廉恥相冒，武力進用，法嚴令具。

translations.literal: Entered goods ones filled offices, exported goods ones removed crime, selections declined, integrity shame mutually deceived, martial force advanced used, laws strict commands complete.
translations.idiomatic: Those who brought in goods got offices, and those who exported goods were pardoned. Appointments declined, integrity and shame were trampled underfoot, military power advanced, and the laws were harsh while the commands were complete.

sentences.zh: 興利之臣自此始也。

translations.literal: Arouse benefit ministers from this began also.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers who promoted profit began from this point.

sentences.zh: 其後漢將歲以數萬騎出擊胡，及車騎將軍衛青取匈奴河南地，筑朔方。

translations.literal: Its after Han generals yearly with several ten thousand cavalry went out attacked Hu, and chariot cavalry general Wei Qing took Xiongnu Yellow River south land, built Shuo Fang.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Han generals each year led tens of thousands of cavalry to attack the Hu, and the General of Chariots and Cavalry, Wei Qing, took the Xiongnu lands south of the Yellow River and built Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 當是時，漢通西南夷道，作者數萬人，千里負擔饋糧，率十餘鐘致一石，散幣於邛僰以集之。

translations.literal: When this time, Han opened southwest barbarians road, workers several ten thousand, thousand li carried loads fed grain, rate ten more zhong delivered one shi, scattered coins at Qiong Bo to gather it.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Han opened roads to the southwestern barbarians, employing tens of thousands of workers. For a thousand li, they carried loads and fed grain, at a rate of more than ten zhong to deliver one shi, and scattered coins at Qiong and Bo to gather laborers.

sentences.zh: 數歲道不通，蠻夷因以數攻，吏發兵誅之。

translations.literal: Several years road not connected, barbarian barbarians therefore frequently attacked, clerks raised troops executed them.
translations.idiomatic: After several years the road remained unopened, so the barbarians repeatedly attacked, and the officials raised troops and executed them.

sentences.zh: 悉巴蜀租賦不足以更之，乃募豪民田南夷，入粟縣官，而內受錢於都內。

translations.literal: All Ba Shu rents taxes insufficient to change it, then recruited rich people farmed south barbarians, entered grain county officials, and internally received money at capital inside.
translations.idiomatic: Even all the taxes of Bashu were insufficient for the task, so wealthy men were recruited to farm among the southern tribes; they turned in grain to the county officials and received cash in the capital.

sentences.zh: 東至滄海之郡，人徒之費擬於南夷。

translations.literal: East to vast sea commandery, people troops expenses comparable to south barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: To the east, as far as Canghai Commandery, the expenses in manpower and transport were comparable to those among the southern tribes.

sentences.zh: 又興十萬餘人筑衛朔方，轉漕甚遼遠，自山東咸被其勞，費數十百巨萬，府庫益虛。

translations.literal: Again raised ten thousand more people built defended Shuo Fang, transported very far distant, from Shan Dong all suffered its labor, cost several ten hundred huge ten thousand, treasuries moreover empty.
translations.idiomatic: They again raised more than a hundred thousand people to build Shuofang and defend it. Transport was extremely distant, and all of Shandong suffered the labor; the cost ran into many millions, and the treasuries grew emptier.

sentences.zh: 乃募民能入奴婢得以終身復，為郎增秩，及入羊為郎，始於此。

translations.literal: Then recruited people could enter slave women got lifetime exemption, became lang increased rank, and entered sheep became lang, began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Then they recruited men who could contribute slaves and women in exchange for lifetime exemption, promoted them to lang, and also made those who contributed sheep into lang. This began at this time.

sentences.zh: 其後四年，而漢遣大將將六將軍，軍十餘萬，擊右賢王，獲首虜萬五千級。

translations.literal: Its after four years, and Han sent great general led six generals, army ten more thousand, attacked right worthy king, obtained heads captives ten five thousand ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later, the Han sent a great general with six generals and an army of more than a hundred thousand to attack the Right Worthy King, and took fifteen thousand heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 明年，大將軍將六將軍仍再出擊胡，得首虜萬九千級。

translations.literal: Next year, great general led six generals still again went out attacked Hu, got heads captives ten nine thousand ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, the great general again led the six generals out against the Hu and took nineteen thousand heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 捕斬首虜之士受賜黃金二十餘萬斤，虜數萬人皆得厚賞，衣食仰給縣官；

translations.literal: Captured beheaded heads captives soldiers received rewarded yellow gold twenty more ten thousand jin, captives several ten thousand people all got thick reward, clothing food looked up supplied county officials;
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers who captured and beheaded the enemy received more than two hundred thousand jin of yellow gold, and the captives, numbering tens of thousands, all received generous rewards; their clothing and food were supplied by the county officials.

sentences.zh: 而漢軍之士馬死者十餘萬，兵甲之財轉漕之費不與焉。

translations.literal: And Han army soldiers horses dead ones ten more thousand, weapons armor wealth transported expenses not included there.
translations.idiomatic: The dead soldiers and horses of the Han army numbered more than a hundred thousand, and the cost of armor and transport is not included.

sentences.zh: 於是大農陳藏錢經秏，賦稅既竭，猶不足以奉戰士。

translations.literal: Therefore, great farmer Chen stored money already expended, taxes already exhausted, still insufficient to support warriors.
translations.idiomatic: At that point, Grand Farmer Chen’s reserves of money were already spent, the taxes were exhausted, and they still were not enough to support the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 有司言：「天子曰『朕聞五帝之教不相復而治，禹湯之法不同道而王，所由殊路，而建德一也。

translations.literal: Officials spoke: 'Son of Heaven said 'I heard five emperors teachings not repeated and governed, Yu Tang laws different ways and kinged, what from different roads, but established virtue one also.
translations.idiomatic: The officials said: “The Son of Heaven has said, ‘I have heard that the teachings of the Five Emperors were not repeated, yet they governed; the laws of Yu and Tang were different, yet they both became kings. What they came from was different, but the virtue they established was the same.

sentences.zh: 北邊未安，朕甚悼之。

translations.literal: North border not peaceful, I very mourn it.
translations.idiomatic: The northern frontier is not at peace, and I am deeply troubled by it.

sentences.zh: 日者，大將軍攻匈奴，斬首虜萬九千級，留蹛無所食。

translations.literal: Recently the great general attacked the Xiongnu, beheaded nineteen thousand heads and captives, and left the detained captives with nothing to eat.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the great general attacked the Xiongnu, beheaded nineteen thousand heads and captives, and left the detained captives with nothing to eat.

sentences.zh: 議令民得買爵及贖禁錮免減罪』。

translations.literal: Discuss ordered people could buy nobility rank and redeem prohibitions imprisonments exempt reduce crimes.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that people be allowed to buy ranks and redeem penalties and confinement, and thereby reduce crimes.

sentences.zh: 請置賞官，命曰武功爵。

translations.literal: Request establish reward officials, named martial merit nobility ranks.
translations.idiomatic: We request the establishment of reward offices, to be called martial merit ranks.

sentences.zh: 級十七萬，凡直三十餘萬金。

translations.literal: Ranks seventeen thousand, altogether worth thirty more ten thousand gold.
translations.idiomatic: There are 170,000 ranks, worth more than 300,000 gold in all.

sentences.zh: 諸買武功爵官首者試補吏，先除；

translations.literal: Various buy martial merit nobility rank officials first ones tested filled clerks, first exempted;
translations.idiomatic: Those who buy the martial merit rank first are tested for office and given priority in exemption;

sentences.zh: 千夫如五大夫；

translations.literal: Thousand leader like five grand masters;
translations.idiomatic: a thousand-man commander is treated like a fifth-grade grand master;

sentences.zh: 其有罪又減二等；

translations.literal: Their had crimes moreover reduced two grades;
translations.idiomatic: if they have committed crimes, their sentence is reduced by two grades;

sentences.zh: 爵得至樂卿：以顯軍功。」

translations.literal: Nobility rank could reach music minister: to display military merit.'
translations.idiomatic: and the rank can rise as high as Leqing, all to display military merit.”

sentences.zh: 軍功多用越等，大者封侯卿大夫，小者郎吏。

translations.literal: Military merits many used jumped grades, big ones sealed marquises ministers grand masters, small ones lang clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Military merit often bypassed the usual ranks, with the greatest being enfeoffed as marquises, ministers, and grand masters, and the lesser as lang and clerks.

sentences.zh: 吏道雜而多端，則官職秏廢。

translations.literal: Clerk ways mixed and many branches, then official duties expended abolished.
translations.idiomatic: When the paths of official advancement become mixed and too many, the offices are worn down and ruined.

sentences.zh: 自公孫弘以春秋之義繩臣下取漢相，張湯用唆文決理為廷尉，於是見知之法生，而廢格沮誹窮治之獄用矣。

translations.literal: From the time Gongsun Hong used the righteousness of the Spring and Autumn Annals to bind his subordinates and became Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang used crafty legal rhetoric to decide cases and became court judge, the law of “seeing and knowing” arose, and the prisons for obstruction, blocking, discouragement, slander, and exhaustive investigation were put to use.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Gongsun Hong used the righteousness of the Spring and Autumn Annals to bind his subordinates and became Han chancellor, and Zhang Tang used crafty legal rhetoric to decide cases and became court judge, the law of “seeing and knowing” arose, and the prisons for obstruction, blocking, discouragement, slander, and exhaustive investigation were put to use.

sentences.zh: 其明年，淮南、衡山、江都王謀反跡見，而公卿尋端治之，竟其黨與，而坐死者數萬人，長吏益慘急而法令明察。

translations.literal: Its next year, Huai Nan, Heng Shan, Jiang Du kings plotted rebellion traces seen, and dukes ministers sought beginnings governed them, exhausted their parties allies, and sat died ones several ten thousand people, senior clerks moreover cruel urgent and laws commands clear examined.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, the traces of the Huainan, Hengshan, and Jiangdu kings’ rebellion were discovered, and the dukes and ministers pursued the case to its root and destroyed their followers. Those who were condemned and died numbered in the tens of thousands, and the senior clerks became even harsher and more exacting, with the laws and commands more and more strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 當是之時，招尊方正賢良文學之士，或至公卿大夫。

translations.literal: When this time, recruited honored upright worthy good literature scholars, or reached dukes ministers grand masters.
translations.idiomatic: At that time they recruited and honored upright, worthy, and learned men, some of whom reached the rank of duke, minister, or grand master.

sentences.zh: 公孫弘以漢相，布被，食不重味，為天下先。

translations.literal: Gong Sun Hong became Han chancellor, cloth coverlet, ate not repeated flavors, was world first.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Hong, as Han chancellor, used a cloth coverlet and ate plain food, and was regarded as a model for the realm.

sentences.zh: 然無益於俗，稍騖於功利矣。

translations.literal: Yet no benefit to customs, gradually raced to merit profit.
translations.idiomatic: Yet this did not help customs, and they gradually drifted toward profit and advantage.

sentences.zh: 其明年，驃騎仍再出擊胡，獲首四萬。

translations.literal: Its next year, super cavalry still again went out attacked Hu, obtained heads forty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, the swift cavalry again went out to attack the Hu and took forty thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 其秋，渾邪王率數萬之眾來降，於是漢發車二萬乘迎之。

translations.literal: Its autumn, Hun Ye king led several ten thousand crowd came surrendered, therefore Han sent carriages twenty thousand teams welcomed them.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, the Hunye King led tens of thousands to surrender, and Han accordingly sent twenty thousand carriages to welcome them.

sentences.zh: 既至，受賞，賜及有功之士。

translations.literal: Having arrived, received rewards, bestowed reached meritorious warriors.
translations.idiomatic: Once they arrived, rewards were bestowed, and the meritorious soldiers received their share.

sentences.zh: 天子憐之，詔曰：「江南火耕水耨，令饑民得流就食江淮閒，欲留，留處。」

translations.literal: The Son of Heaven pitied them and issued an edict: “In Jiangnan they burn off fields and weed by water; let the hungry people move to seek food between the Jiang and Huai; those who wish to stay may remain there.”
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven pitied them and issued an edict: “In Jiangnan they burn off fields and weed by water; let the hungry people move to seek food between the Jiang and Huai; those who wish to stay may remain there.”

sentences.zh: 遣使冠蓋相屬於道，護之，下巴蜀粟以振之。

translations.idiomatic: They sent messengers, and official hats and canopies continuously connected on the road. They protected them and sent down Bashu grain to relieve them.

translations.literal: Its next year, Son of Heaven began toured commanderies kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, the Son of Heaven began to tour the commanderies and kingdoms.

translations.idiomatic: Going east, they crossed the Yellow River, and the governor of Hedong did not expect the travel to arrive and was not prepared, so he committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 行西踰隴，隴西守以行往卒，天子從官不得食，隴西守自殺。

translations.literal: Traveled west crossed Long, Long Xi governor with travel went troops, Son of Heaven attendants not got food, Long Xi governor committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Traveling west, they crossed Long, and the governor of Longxi, with the travel, went with troops. The Son of Heaven's attendants did not get food, and the governor of Longxi committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 於是上北出蕭關，從數萬騎，獵新秦中，以勒邊兵而歸。

translations.literal: Therefore, emperor north exited Xiao Guan, followed several ten thousand cavalry, hunted new Qin middle, to restrain border troops and return.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the emperor went north and exited Xiaoguan, followed by several tens of thousands of cavalry, hunted in the new Qin middle, and restrained the border troops and returned.

sentences.zh: 新秦中或千里無亭徼，於是誅北地太守以下，而令民得畜牧邊縣，官假馬母，三歲而歸，及息什一，以除告緡，用充仞新秦中。

translations.literal: New Qin middle or thousand li no watch stations, therefore executed Bei Di grand administrator below, and ordered people could raise livestock border counties, officials lent mare mothers, three years and return, and increased one tenth, to remove accuse string money, used fill populate new Qin middle.
translations.idiomatic: In the new Qin middle, for a thousand li there were no watch stations. Therefore, they executed the grand administrator of Beidi and below, and ordered that the people could raise livestock in border counties. The officials lent mare mothers, and after three years they returned them, and the increase was one-tenth, to remove the accusation of string money, and they used this to fill and populate the new Qin middle.

sentences.zh: 既得寶鼎，立后土、太一祠，公卿議封禪事，而天下郡國皆豫治道橋，繕故宮，及當馳道縣，縣治官儲，設供具，而望以待幸。

translations.idiomatic: Having obtained the precious ding, they established the sacrifices to Houtu and Taiyi. sentences.zh: 其明年，南越反，西羌侵邊為桀。

translations.literal: Its next year, Nan Yue rebelled, Xi Qiang invaded border became rebellious.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, Nanyue rebelled, and the Xiqiang invaded the border and became rebellious.

translations.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven for Shan Dong not sufficient, pardoned world [prisoners], using south tower boat troops twenty more ten thousand attacked Nan Yue, several ten thousand sent San He west cavalry attacked Xi Qiang, moreover several ten thousand crossed Yellow River built Ling Ju.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the Son of Heaven, because Shandong was not sufficient, pardoned the world's [prisoners]. Using more than two hundred thousand southern tower boat troops, they attacked Nanyue. Several tens of thousands were sent with cavalry west of Sanhe to attack the Xiqiang, and moreover several tens of thousands crossed the Yellow River and built Lingju.

sentences.zh: 初置張掖、酒泉郡，而上郡、朔方、西河、河西開田官，斥塞卒六十萬人戍田之。

translations.literal: Initially established Zhang Ye, Jiu Quan commanderies, and Shang Jun, Shuo Fang, Xi He, He Xi opened field officials, expanded border troops sixty ten thousand garrisoned farmed them.
translations.idiomatic: They initially established the commanderies of Zhangye and Jiuquan, and in Shangjun, Shuofang, Xihe, and Hexi, they opened field officials. They expanded border troops, and six hundred thousand garrisoned and farmed them.

sentences.zh: 中國繕道餽糧，遠者三千，近者千餘里，皆仰給大農。

translations.literal: Central states repaired roads sent grain, far ones three thousand, near ones thousand more li, all looked up supplied great farmer.
translations.idiomatic: The central states repaired roads and sent grain. The far ones were three thousand li, and the near ones were more than a thousand li, and all looked up to and were supplied by the Great Farmer.

sentences.zh: 邊兵不足，乃發武庫工官兵器以贍之。

translations.literal: Border troops insufficient, then issued martial storehouse craftsmen official weapons to support them.
translations.idiomatic: The border troops were insufficient, so they issued weapons from the martial storehouse, craftsmen, and officials to support them.

sentences.zh: 車騎馬乏絕，縣官錢少，買馬難得，乃著令，令封君以下至三百石以上吏，以差出牝馬天下亭，亭有畜牸馬，歲課息。

translations.literal: Chariot cavalry horses lacked exhausted, county officials money few, buy horses difficult got, then established command, ordered sealed lords below to three hundred shi above clerks, by differences sent out female horses world pavilions, pavilions had raised female horses, yearly assessed interest.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot and cavalry horses were lacking and exhausted, and the county officials' money was few. It was difficult to get horses to buy, so they established a command, ordering sealed lords and below to clerks of three hundred shi and above, by differences, to send out female horses to the world's pavilions. The pavilions had raised female horses, and they yearly assessed interest.

sentences.zh: 齊相卜式上書曰：「臣聞主憂臣辱。

translations.literal: Qi chancellor Bu Shi memorialed said: 'Minister heard lord worries minister shames.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor of Qi, Bu Shi, submitted a memorial saying: 'I, your minister, have heard that when the lord worries, the minister is shamed.

sentences.zh: 南越反，臣願父子與齊習船者往死之。」

translations.literal: Nan Yue rebelled, minister wishes father son with Qi practiced boat ones go die for it.'
translations.idiomatic: Nanyue has rebelled, and I, your minister, wish that my father and son, together with those from Qi who practice the boats, go and die for it.'

sentences.zh: 天子下詔曰：「卜式雖躬耕牧，不以為利，有餘輒助縣官之用。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven issued edict said: 'Bu Shi although personally farmed pastured, not took as profit, had surplus then assisted county officials use.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven issued an edict saying: 'Bu Shi, although he personally farmed and pastured, did not take it as profit, and when he had surplus, he then assisted the county officials' use.

sentences.zh: 今天下不幸有急，而式奮願父子死之，雖未戰，可謂義形於內。

translations.literal: Now world unfortunately has urgency, and Shi aroused wished father son die for it, although not yet battled, can be called righteousness shaped within.
translations.idiomatic: Now the world unfortunately has urgency, and Shi aroused and wished that his father and son die for it. Although they have not yet battled, it can be called righteousness shaped within.

sentences.zh: 賜爵關內侯，金六十斤，田十頃。」

translations.literal: Granted nobility Guan Nei Hou, gold sixty jin, fields ten qing.'
translations.idiomatic: I grant him the nobility of Guannei Hou, sixty jin of gold, and ten qing of fields.'

sentences.zh: 布告天下，天下莫應。

translations.literal: It was proclaimed to the realm, but none in the realm responded.
translations.idiomatic: It was proclaimed to the realm, but none in the realm responded.

sentences.zh: 列侯以百數，皆莫求從軍擊羌、越。

translations.literal: Arranged marquises by hundred counted, all none sought follow army attack Qiang, Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The arranged marquises numbered by the hundreds, and all none sought to follow the army to attack the Qiang and Yue.

sentences.zh: 至酎，少府省金，而列侯坐酎金失侯者百餘人。

translations.literal: At the libation ceremony, the Shaofu inspected the gold, and more than a hundred ranked marquises were convicted over their libation gold and lost their marquisates.
translations.idiomatic: At the libation ceremony, the Shaofu inspected the gold, and more than a hundred ranked marquises were convicted over their libation gold and lost their marquisates.

sentences.zh: 乃拜式為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Then appointed Shi as Imperial Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Then they appointed Shi as Imperial Censor.

sentences.zh: 式既在位，見郡國多不便縣官作鹽鐵，鐵器苦惡，賈貴，或彊令民賣買之。

translations.literal: Shi already in position, saw commanderies kingdoms many inconvenient county officials made salt iron, iron tools bitter bad, merchants expensive, or strongly ordered people bought sold them.
translations.idiomatic: Shi, already in position, saw that the commanderies and kingdoms found it many and inconvenient that the county officials made salt and iron. The iron tools were bitter and bad, the merchants were expensive, or they strongly ordered the people to buy and sell them.

sentences.zh: 而船有算，商者少，物貴，乃因孔僅言船算事。

translations.literal: And boats had tax, merchants few, goods expensive, then through Kong Jin spoke boat tax affairs.
translations.idiomatic: And boats had a tax, merchants were few, and goods were expensive. Then, through Kong Jin, he spoke of boat tax affairs.

sentences.zh: 上由是不悅卜式。

translations.literal: Emperor therefore not pleased Bu Shi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore was not pleased with Bu Shi.

sentences.zh: 漢連兵三歲，誅羌，滅南越，番禺以西至蜀南者置初郡十七，且以其故俗治，毋賦稅。

translations.literal: Han connected troops three years, executed Qiang, extinguished Nan Yue, Pan Yu west to Shu south ones established initial commanderies seventeen, moreover with their former customs governed, no taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Han connected troops for three years, executed the Qiang, and extinguished Nanyue. They established seventeen initial commanderies from Panyu west to Shu south, and moreover governed them with their former customs, with no taxes.

sentences.zh: 南陽、漢中以往郡，各以地比給初郡吏卒奉食幣物，傳車馬被具。

translations.literal: Nan Yang, Han Zhong past commanderies, each with land proportion supplied initial commanderies clerks troops provisions food currency goods, relay carriages horses covered equipment.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies past Nanyang and Hanzhong, each according to their land proportion, supplied the initial commanderies' clerks and troops with provisions, food, currency, and goods, and relay carriages, horses, and covered equipment.

sentences.zh: 而初郡時時小反，殺吏，漢發南方吏卒往誅之，閒歲萬餘人，費皆仰給大農。

translations.literal: And initial commanderies sometimes small rebelled, killed clerks, Han sent southern clerks troops went executed them, between years ten thousand more people, expenses all looked up supplied great farmer.
translations.idiomatic: And the initial commanderies sometimes had small rebellions and killed clerks. Han sent southern clerks and troops to go and execute them, and between years, more than ten thousand people were involved. The expenses all looked up to and were supplied by the Great Farmer.

sentences.zh: 大農以均輸調鹽鐵助賦，故能贍之。

translations.literal: Great farmer with equal transport regulated salt iron assisted taxes, therefore could support them.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Farmer, with equal transport, regulated salt and iron to assist taxes, and therefore could support them.

sentences.zh: 然兵所過縣，為以訾給毋乏而已，不敢言擅賦法矣。

translations.literal: Yet troops passed counties, for with wealth supplied not lacked only, not dared speak monopolized tax laws.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in counties that the troops passed, they only supplied with wealth so as not to lack, and did not dare to speak of monopolized tax laws.

sentences.zh: 其明年，元封元年，卜式貶秩為太子太傅。

translations.literal: Its next year, Yuan Feng first year, Bu Shi demoted rank became Crown Prince grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the first year of Yuanfeng, Bu Shi was demoted in rank and became grand tutor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 而桑弘羊為治粟都尉，領大農，盡代僅筦天下鹽鐵。

translations.literal: And Sang Hong Yang became Governing Grain colonel, led great farmer, completely replaced Jin managed world salt iron.
translations.idiomatic: And Sang Hongyang became Governing Grain Colonel, led the Great Farmer, and completely replaced Jin in managing the world's salt and iron.

sentences.zh: 弘羊以諸官各自市，相與爭，物故騰躍，而天下賦輸或不償其僦費，乃請置大農部丞數十人，分部主郡國，各往往縣置均輸鹽鐵官，令遠方各以其物貴時商賈所轉販者為賦，而相灌輸。

translations.literal: Hong Yang with various officials each self purchased, mutually contended, goods therefore leaped jumped, and world taxes transports or not repaid their hired expenses, then requested established great farmer division assistants several ten people, divided sections mastered commanderies kingdoms, each often county established equal transport salt iron officials, ordered distant places each with their goods expensive time merchants transferred sold ones as taxes, and mutually irrigated input.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyang, because the various officials each purchased for themselves and mutually contended, goods therefore leaped and jumped, and the world's taxes and transports sometimes did not repay their hired expenses. Then he requested to establish several tens of Great Farmer division assistants, divided into sections to master commanderies and kingdoms. Each often established equal transport salt and iron officials in counties, and ordered distant places, each with their goods at expensive times, to use what merchants transferred and sold as taxes, and to mutually irrigate and input.

sentences.zh: 置平準于京師，都受天下委輸。

translations.literal: Established level standard at capital, capital received world entrusted transports.
translations.idiomatic: They established the level standard at the capital, and the capital received the world's entrusted transports.

sentences.zh: 召工官治車諸器，皆仰給大農。

translations.literal: Summoned craftsmen officials repaired carriages various tools, all looked up supplied great farmer.
translations.idiomatic: They summoned craftsmen officials to repair carriages and various tools, and all looked up to and were supplied by the Great Farmer.

sentences.zh: 大農之諸官盡籠天下之貨物，貴即賣之，賤則買之。

translations.literal: Great farmer various officials completely contained world goods, expensive then sold them, cheap then bought them.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Farmer's various officials completely contained the world's goods, and when expensive, they sold them, and when cheap, they bought them.

sentences.zh: 如此，富商大賈無所牟大利，則反本，而萬物不得騰踴。

translations.literal: Like this, rich merchants great traders nowhere sought great profits, then returned to fundamentals, and myriad things not got to leap jump.
translations.idiomatic: Like this, rich merchants and great traders had nowhere to seek great profits, so they returned to fundamentals, and the myriad things did not get to leap and jump.

sentences.zh: 故抑天下物，名曰「平準」。

translations.literal: Therefore, they stabilized goods throughout the realm, and the policy was named “Equalization.”
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, they stabilized prices throughout the realm, and the policy was named “Equalization.”

sentences.zh: 天子以為然，許之。

translations.literal: Son of Heaven considered it so, permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven considered it so and permitted it.

sentences.zh: 於是天子北至朔方，東到太山，巡海上，并北邊以歸。

translations.literal: Therefore, Son of Heaven north to Shuo Fang, east to Tai Shan, toured sea above, along north border to return.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the Son of Heaven went north to Shuofang, east to Taishan, toured above the sea, and along the northern border returned.

sentences.zh: 所過賞賜，用帛百餘萬匹，錢金以巨萬計，皆取足大農。

translations.literal: Passed places rewarded bestowed, used silk hundred more ten thousand bolts, money gold counted in huge ten thousands, all took sufficient great farmer.
translations.idiomatic: In the places they passed, they rewarded and bestowed, using more than a million bolts of silk, and money and gold counted in huge ten thousands, and all took sufficient from the Great Farmer.

sentences.zh: 弘羊又請令吏得入粟補官，及罪人贖罪。

translations.literal: Hong Yang moreover requested ordered clerks could enter grain supplement offices, and criminals redeem crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Hongyang moreover requested to order that clerks could enter grain to supplement the offices, and criminals could redeem their crimes.

sentences.zh: 令民能入粟甘泉各有差，以復終身，不告緡。

translations.literal: Ordered people could enter grain Gan Quan each had differences, to exempt lifetime, not accuse string money.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered that people could enter grain at Ganquan, each having differences, to exempt for a lifetime, and not to accuse string money.

sentences.zh: 他郡各輸急處，而諸農各致粟，山東漕益歲六百萬石。

translations.literal: Other commanderies each transported urgent places, and various farmers each brought grain, Shan Dong transported moreover year six hundred ten thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Other commanderies each transported to urgent places, and the various farmers each brought grain. Shandong transported, moreover, six million shi per year.

sentences.zh: 一歲之中，太倉、甘泉倉滿。

translations.literal: One year middle, great granary, Gan Quan granary full.
translations.idiomatic: Within one year, the great granary and Ganquan granary were full.

sentences.zh: 邊餘穀諸物均輸帛五百萬匹。

translations.literal: Border surplus grain various goods equal transported silk five hundred ten thousand bolts.
translations.idiomatic: Border surplus grain and various goods were equally transported, and silk was five million bolts.

sentences.zh: 民不益賦而天下用饒。

translations.literal: People not increased taxes and world use abundant.
translations.idiomatic: The people did not increase taxes, and the world's use was abundant.

sentences.zh: 於是弘羊賜爵左庶長，黃金再百斤焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon Sang Hongyang was granted the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude and two hundred jin of gold.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Sang Hongyang was granted the rank of Left Chief of the Multitude and two hundred jin of gold.

sentences.zh: 是歲小旱，上令官求雨，卜式言曰：「縣官當食租衣稅而已，今弘羊令吏坐市列肆，販物求利。

translations.literal: That year there was a slight drought; the emperor ordered officials to pray for rain. Bu Shi said: “The officials should live on rents and dress on taxes alone; now Sang Hongyang has clerks sit in market rows and shops, peddling goods for profit.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was a slight drought; the emperor ordered officials to pray for rain. Bu Shi said: “The officials should live on rents and dress on taxes alone; now Sang Hongyang has clerks sit in market rows and shops, peddling goods for profit.

sentences.zh: 亨弘羊，天乃雨。」

translations.literal: Execute Sang Hongyang, and heaven will then rain.”
translations.idiomatic: Execute Sang Hongyang, and heaven will then rain.”

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：農工商交易之路通，而龜貝金錢刀布之幣興焉。

translations.literal: Grand Historian said: farming commerce artisans exchange roads connected, and turtle shells cowries gold money knives cloth currencies arose there.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Historian said: When the roads of exchange for farming, commerce, and artisans were connected, the currencies of turtle shells, cowries, gold, money, knives, and cloth arose.

sentences.zh: 所從來久遠，自高辛氏之前尚矣，靡得而記云。

translations.literal: What came from long distant, from Gao Xin clan before still was, could not be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: What it came from was long and distant, and from before the Gaoxin clan it still was, but it could not be recorded.

sentences.zh: 故書道唐虞之際，詩述殷周之世，安寧則長庠序，先本絀末，以禮義防于利；

translations.literal: Therefore, writings spoke Tang Yu time, poems described Yin Zhou age, peaceful then grew schools, first fundamentals reduced ends, with rites righteousness guarded against profits;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the writings spoke of the time of Tang and Yu, and the poems described the age of Yin and Zhou. When peaceful, they grew schools, put fundamentals first and reduced ends, and with rites and righteousness guarded against profits;

sentences.zh: 事變多故而亦反是。

translations.literal: Affairs changed many troubles and also reversed this.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs changed and had many troubles, they also reversed this.

sentences.zh: 是以物盛則衰，時極而轉，一質一文，終始之變也。

translations.literal: Therefore, things flourish then decline, time extreme then turn, one solid one pattern, beginning end change also.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, when things flourish, they then decline. When time reaches an extreme, it then turns. One solid, one pattern—this is the change of beginning and end.

sentences.zh: 禹貢九州，各因其土地所宜，人民所多少而納職焉。

translations.literal: Yu tribute nine provinces, each according to their land suitable, people more less and paid duties there.
translations.idiomatic: In Yu's tribute, the nine provinces, each according to what was suitable for their land, and whether their people were more or less, paid duties.

sentences.zh: 湯武承獘易變，使民不倦，各兢兢所以為治，而稍陵遲衰微。

translations.literal: Tang Wu inherited exhaustion easily changed, made people not weary, each earnestly so governed, but gradually declined weakened.
translations.idiomatic: Tang and Wu inherited exhaustion and easily changed, making the people not weary. Each earnestly governed in this way, but they gradually declined and weakened.

sentences.zh: 齊桓公用管仲之謀，通輕重之權，徼山海之業，以朝諸侯，用區區之齊顯成霸名。

translations.literal: Qi Huan duke used Guan Zhong strategy, connected light heavy power, cornered mountain sea industries, to make audience feudal lords, used small small Qi displayed became hegemon name.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Huan of Qi used Guan Zhong's strategy, connected the power of light and heavy, cornered the industries of mountains and seas, and made audiences with the feudal lords. Using the small Qi, he displayed and became a hegemon name.

sentences.zh: 魏用李克，盡地力，為彊君。

translations.literal: Wei used Li Ke, exhausted land strength, became strong ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Wei used Li Ke, exhausted the land's strength, and became a strong ruler.

sentences.zh: 自是以後，天下爭於戰國，貴詐力而賤仁義，先富有而後推讓。

translations.literal: From this after, world contended in Warring States, valued deceit force but cheapened benevolence righteousness, first rich had then afterward yielded.
translations.idiomatic: From this time afterward, the world contended in the Warring States, valued deceit and force but cheapened benevolence and righteousness, and put wealth first and then afterward yielded.

sentences.zh: 故庶人之富者或累巨萬，而貧者或不厭糟糠；

translations.literal: Therefore, commoners rich ones or accumulated huge ten thousand, but poor ones or not satisfied with bran husks;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, the rich among commoners sometimes accumulated huge ten thousands, but the poor ones sometimes were not satisfied with bran and husks;

sentences.zh: 有國彊者或并群小以臣諸侯，而弱國或絕祀而滅世。

translations.literal: Had states strong ones or annexed groups small to serve feudal lords, but weak states or cut sacrifices extinguished generations.
translations.idiomatic: Those who had strong states sometimes annexed groups of small ones to serve the feudal lords, but weak states sometimes cut sacrifices and extinguished generations.

sentences.zh: 以至於秦，卒并海內。

translations.literal: To arrived at Qin, finally united within seas.
translations.idiomatic: Until they arrived at Qin, which finally united what was within the seas.

sentences.zh: 虞夏之幣，金為三品，或黃，或白，或赤；

translations.literal: Yu Xia currencies, gold as three kinds, or yellow, or white, or red;
translations.idiomatic: In the currencies of Yu and Xia, gold was of three kinds: either yellow, or white, or red;

sentences.zh: 或錢，或布，或刀，或龜貝。

translations.literal: Or coins, or cloth, or knives, or turtle shells cowries.
translations.idiomatic: or coins, or cloth, or knives, or turtle shells and cowries.

sentences.zh: 及至秦，中一國之幣為（三）［二］等，黃金以溢名，為上幣；

translations.literal: And to Qin, unifying one state currencies as (three) [two] grades, yellow gold with yi named, as upper currency;
translations.idiomatic: And when they reached Qin, unifying one state's currencies as (three) [two] grades, yellow gold was named with yi and was the upper currency;

sentences.zh: 銅錢識曰半兩，重如其文，為下幣。

translations.literal: Copper coins inscription said half liang, heavy like its writing, as lower currency.
translations.idiomatic: Copper coins had the inscription 'half liang', weighed like their writing, and were the lower currency.

sentences.zh: 而珠玉、龜貝、銀錫之屬為器飾寶藏，不為幣。

translations.literal: And pearls jade, turtle shells cowries, silver tin kind as vessel decorations treasure stores, not as currency.
translations.idiomatic: And pearls, jade, turtle shells, cowries, silver, and tin and their kind were used as vessel decorations and treasure stores, but they were not used as the currency.

sentences.zh: 然各隨時而輕重無常。

translations.literal: Yet each followed time and light heavy no constant.
translations.idiomatic: Yet each followed the time, and light and heavy had no constant.

sentences.zh: 於是外攘夷狄，內興功業，海內之士力耕不足糧馕，女子紡績不足衣服。

translations.literal: Therefore, externally repelled barbarian barbarians, internally aroused merit works, within seas scholars strength farmed insufficient grain food, women spun wove insufficient clothes.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, externally they repelled the barbarian Di, and internally they aroused merit works. The scholars within the seas, with strength, farmed but had insufficient grain and food, and women spun and wove but had insufficient clothes.

sentences.zh: 古者嘗竭天下之資財以奉其上，猶自以為不足也。

translations.literal: Ancient ones often exhausted world resources wealth to support their superiors, still self considered insufficient also.
translations.idiomatic: The ancients often exhausted the world's resources and wealth to support their superiors, and still considered themselves insufficient.

sentences.zh: 無異故云，事勢之流，相激使然，曷足怪焉。

translations.literal: No different therefore speak, affairs situations flow, mutually stimulated made so, why sufficient strange there.
translations.idiomatic: There is no different reason to speak of it. The flow of affairs and situations, mutually stimulating, made it so. Why is this sufficient to be strange?
